description.p: Quoth is private, open-source voice dictation for Linux. Press a key, speak, and Quoth pastes the transcription into supported focused applications. Transcription runs entirely on your own device, so your voice and text never leave your machine: no cloud, no account. Quoth downloads your chosen speech model once, then works completely offline.

ul.li: Fully offline transcription powered by whisper.cpp
Vulkan GPU acceleration, Intel NPU encoder acceleration, and CPU fallback
Start dictating with a key of your choice or your desktop's own shortcut
Clipboard-based delivery to supported focused applications
Translate speech to English with the Tiny, Base and Small models
Themes for the recording overlay and color skins for the app

screenshot.caption: Try private, offline dictation during guided setup

description.p: First release of offline voice dictation for Linux on Wayland.

ul.li: Guided setup, microphone selection and configurable shortcuts
Local CPU and Vulkan transcription, with Intel NPU encoder support
Overlay themes, an experimental orb style and color skins for the app
Script control over D-Bus, and a tray item that copies the last dictation again
English translation, opt-in error reporting and package-manager update guidance
